name: Chan Thread Watch
description: Adds threads to Chan Thread Watch on this computer, through its local API on 127.0.0.1.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:*; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
